pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions within 1.5 ATR of a micro-consolidation high; only scale in after a verified liquidity sweep and structural breakout confirmation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block validation and minimum 3.0 ATR distance from current session value area high/low before opening execution tickets.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00 profit and trail remaining volume using a dynamic parabolic SAR to capture asymmetric $15-$30+ runs.
